name: usermods-launch-video
description: The usermods launch video, a HyperFrames composition. See README.md.

scripts.render: node scripts/prepare.mjs && node scripts/render.mjs --quality delivery --fps 30 --output out/usermods-launch.mp4
scripts.render:draft: node scripts/prepare.mjs && node scripts/render.mjs --quality draft --fps 30 --output out/usermods-launch-draft.mp4
scripts.sheet:all: for v in 16x9 1x1 9x16 x; do sh scripts/contact-sheet.sh out/usermods-launch-$v.mp4 out/contact-sheet-$v.png; done
